errors.generic: Ek unexpected error aayi. Kripya dobara try karein.

network.offline: Internet connection nahi hai. Kripya apna network check karein.

validation.failed: Field validation fail ho gaya; enter kiye gaye values check karein.

request.malformed: Request data valid JSON nahi hai.
request.method_not_allowed: Yeh HTTP method allowed nahi hai.

auth.token_invalid: Session expire ho gaya ya token invalid hai. Dobara sign in karein.
auth.account_disabled: User account deactivate kar diya gaya hai.

permission.denied: Aapke paas yeh action perform karne ki permission nahi hai.

errors.not_found: Object missing hai ya kisi doosri shop ka hai.

shop.header_missing: Shop-scoped endpoint par X-Shop-Id header missing hai.
shop.not_found: Shop missing hai, delete ho chuki hai, ya access denied hai.

rate.limited: Bahut saari requests aayi hain. Thoda wait karein.

idempotency.key_reused: Idempotency-Key pehle se kisi doosri request ke liye use ho chuki hai.
idempotency.in_progress: Is Idempotency-Key ke sath original request abhi process ho rahi hai.

concurrency.version_mismatch: Record ka version kisi aur ne change kar diya; refresh karke try karein.

otp.cooldown: Kripya naya OTP request karne se pehle thoda wait karein.
otp.too_many_requests: Hourly OTP limit khatam ho gayi hai; baad mein try karein.
otp.not_found: Koi pending OTP challenge nahi mila; naya OTP request karein.
otp.expired: OTP expire ho gaya hai; naya OTP request karein.
otp.locked: Bahut saare incorrect attempts; naya OTP request karein.

staff.cannot_modify_self: Aap apni khud ki membership change nahi kar sakte.
staff.cannot_modify_owner: Shop owner ko change ya remove nahi kiya ja sakta.
staff.insufficient_rank: Sirf shop owner hi yeh role change ya grant kar sakta hai.
staff.role_not_assignable: Owner role kisi ko assign nahi kiya ja sakta.
staff.invalid_status_change: Yeh status change allowed nahi hai.

server.error: Unexpected server error; kripya dobara try karein.

auth.welcomeSubtitle: Apni repair shop ko fast, bharosemand aur paperless banayein.
auth.phoneSubtitle: Hum aapke number par 6-digit OTP code bhejenge.
auth.verifySubtitle: par bheja gaya 6-digit code enter karein
auth.profileSubtitle: Isse aapke staff aur customers aapko pehchaan sakenge.
auth.nameTooShort: Naam kam se kam 2 characters ka hona chahiye
auth.nameTooLong: Naam 120 characters se zyada nahi ho sakta
